game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Hidden Spring Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before giant bats overload Hidden Spring.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before giant bats overload Hidden Spring. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
